question: Do this project's strategies and signals have structural breaks, and where does the data put them?
why_this_matters_here: The owner has asked repeatedly whether a strategy that worked last decade still works now. Every answer so far came from splitting the sample at a date I chose -- 2011/2019, 2013/2019, 2018/2022. That is an assumption wearing the clothes of a test. A structural break test finds the break point FROM the data and tests whether one exists at all, which converts a recurring argument into a measurement.
from_the_reference_shelf: CLAUDE.md section 3 names structural-break tests as a technique from the Lopez de Prado body of work not yet applied here. A grep of 272 recorded steps found zero mentions of CUSUM, Chow, Quandt-Andrews or Bai-Perron. This is the first.

reference_series: equal-weight universe from the 2011-2026 clean panel
data.signal_ic_series: the eight price-signal IC series from Step 257, so breaks in a signal can be separated from breaks in a book

method.primary: supremum Wald test for a break in mean at an unknown date, scanning every candidate break between the 15th and 85th percentile of the sample so the statistic is not driven by the endpoints
method.null_distribution: obtained by a moving-block bootstrap that resamples the series under the no-break null and recomputes the supremum, rather than by table lookup. The sup-Wald statistic has a non-standard distribution and asymptotic critical values assume independence that weekly returns do not have.
method.secondary: CUSUM of squares for variance instability, since a strategy whose volatility regime changes is a different object even if its mean does not move

interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_no_series_shows_a_break: the owner's regime hypothesis is not supported by these series, and the window splits used so far were arbitrary but harmless
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_breaks_are_found_and_cluster_at_one_d: that date, not one I chose, is the right place to split every future test, and prior results split elsewhere should be re-read
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_breaks_are_found_at_different_dates_p: the strategies are responding to different regimes, which would be the first evidence in this project that they are not all the same bet
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_a_break_is_found_at_the_start_of_the_: it would mean the sample every strategy was selected on begins at a genuine discontinuity, which weakens every backtest here rather than any single one
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.always: a structural break is a description of the past. It does not predict the next break, and finding one does not tell anyone what to hold.

cumulative_trial_warning: These 5 stack on every configuration searched across 272 recorded steps.
